text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! Ehehe, I'll take good 
care of it!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make sure we're together forever 
and ever! Even when we eat meals and 
snacks—

text_block_list.text:
...Ah, thinking about snacks made me 
really crave carrot ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally buying some on the way home! 
Hmm-hmm-hmm, carrot ice cream~♪
